text: 《金師子章》T1881：法藏章文（本文）與承遷注分層
classification_is: AI reconstruction (Claude), not human-audited; 本文 units are 法藏, 注 units are 承遷 and are never attributed to 法藏
commentary_sources: Only 承遷’s notes in the file. Each 注 unit is anchored to the 本文 unit it follows in the combined file FO2-KS.txt (column commentary); every anchor agrees with the layer order. 五教章 and 清涼 are not in the repository.

wu_units.form: 師子雖有生滅，金體本無增減
五教之等（聲聞、始、終、頓、圓）
金 況 法界體，師子 喻 法界用
幻法紛然 / 真空不動
金喻一真之性，師子喻緣起事法
理本無生，隨諸緣法成差別相
師子雖則相殊，金且不隨殊變
離真理之外無別事相…無生生也
以理成事，事法不定，互相容攝
真理隨緣成諸事法，各各不實
師子相不實，當體是金，不可壞

ji_units.form: 拒：有為諸法待壞而滅；本來寂滅
ji_units.note: polysemy of 壞; rejects ceasing as something that must come; plan answer open (perhaps the reading under the total class, where nothing is distinguished to arise or cease)

ji_units.form: 拒：法有自生；法本無生，從緣有故
ji_units.note: 承遷 on gate 5 heading; plan answer: 生 relative to class and through 缘; agrees that there is no self-standing 生

ji_units.form: 拒：有自體之生；生而無生
拒：生為自性之生；由緣生非生方得名生

weidu_reasons.reason: reason: 名言路絕 (beyond names); the grammar has no form for what no sentence reaches
reason: 相即 (all is one) is not class equivalence (that would collapse the distinctions JSZ-P-06-015, -017 keep); needs an operation the grammar lacks
reason as P-06-016; 因果歷然 keeps causal order
reason: each hair contains the whole lion: whole-in-part containment; the grammar has no containment relation; a candidate is a greatest fixed point (non-wellfounded), §4.7
reason: infinite mutual nesting (重重無盡); cf. 不穷 needs dependent choice (§4.2)
reason: 眼即耳 (identity of distinct parts, 相即) is not available; class equivalence would erase the parts' difference
承遷 couplet on gate 4; reason: paradox 相即無相，非相即相
承遷 couplet on gate 5; reason: 生即無生 asserts and denies 生 of one event; readable only if the two are relative to two classes (the plan's answer), which the line does not state
承遷 on gate 7; reason: mutual reflection (交映, 重重) needs containment
承遷 on gate 8; reason: 舉一即多 (相即)
承遷 on P-07-010; reason: 小中含大 (containment)
承遷 on P-07-018; reason: 相即相遍
承遷 on P-07-027; reason: 一即多 (相即)
承遷 (not 法藏) on P-08-003; reason: 無孤單法 is a model property stated without definition, and 一一相中含無盡相 needs containment; strains the plan, which admits isolated events (§4.3)

most_important.line: 緣起 := 起但是緣: the arising is nothing but the 缘 (法藏)
謂以金無自性: in 法藏’s text the gold too lacks self-nature
承遷 on P-01-002: 喻真理不變: the commentary turns 金無自性 into an unchanging 理
以金收師子盡 (相分, 法藏)
金外更無師子可得 (相分, 法藏)
師子生時，但是金生: 生 under the lion reading is 住 under the gold reading (the plan’s class relativity); the text ranks the gold reading as 正見
師子雖有生滅，金體本無增減 (相分, 法藏)
主伴交輝，理事齊現 (nondual, 法藏), beside the 相分 lines
說師子，用表無明 (with P-07-036 金體彰真性): 法藏 himself values the two sides
總相/別相: whole and parts at one time
同相 by one 緣起, 異相 by 各不相到
成相 諸根合會 / 壞相 諸緣各住自位: two synchronic readings at two grains, not 生 then 亡
若看師子…則師子顯金隱 (with -008, -009): what is manifest depends on the reading
九世有隔不同，相由成立: times established through each other
同為一念: the mutual dependence of times gives one co-present cluster (cf. §4.1 环为同时之聚)
聲聞教 := 緣生之法念念生滅: the view nearest the plan is ranked lowest of five (判教, 戊 via P-06-002)
頓教: 二相互奪兩亡 (mutual)
承遷 on P-06-009: 以理奪事，事隱理顯 (one-sided)
入涅槃: 見師子與金二相俱盡: in the end the gold is not privileged either
金喻一真之性，師子喻緣起事法: 承遷, not 法藏
理本無生: 承遷, not 法藏
顯法界中無孤單法: 承遷, not 法藏; denies isolated dharmas, which the plan admits
理事合論 況阿賴耶識: link to 起信論 QXL-JS-030
承遷: 生與無生互成互奪，奪則無生，成乃緣生: 生 relative to two operations
承遷 quoting 僧肇: 功流萬世而常存: continuation valued positively, opposite in sign to 起信論’s 相續 = 無明

strains_with_plan.strain: The 相分 is 法藏’s own (confirmed in the base layer), and P-07-035/036 add a valuation: 師子 表無明, 金 彰真性. §5.4 should add these two lines.

法藏’s base text also weakens the split: 金無自性 (gate 1), 空無自性…不礙幻存 (gate 2), 同時成立, 理事齊現, and at the end 二相俱盡. The 相分 and the 不二 are in the same text, as §5.4 says; gate 1 and gate 10 should be cited with 理事齊現.
承遷 consistently hardens the split: 金無自性 → 真理不變; 互奪兩亡 → 以理奪事; 不待壞 → 不可壞. Lines quoted in plan versions before v10 as 法藏’s (金喻一真之性, 理本無生, 無孤單法) are all 承遷 (confirmed by layer and position).

Confirms §一: 成/壞 are synchronic readings of parts and whole. 壞 is polysemous within the file: P-08-003 壞相 (各住自位), P-09-002 更不待壞 (destruction over time), C-054 壞波, C-109 不可壞; the plan must cite only P-08-003 for 壞相.

strains_with_plan.plan: §一 位置不自立，而相对于类
strains_with_plan.strain: Best support in either text for position relative to class: 師子生時，但是金生 is 生 under one reading and 住 under the other; but the text ranks the gold reading (正見), which the plan does not.
法藏 places 緣生之法念念生滅 (the plan’s moment-to-moment continuation) in the lowest teaching; the plan’s centre is, for 法藏, a partial view. Registered 戊 (判教).
Supports time from mutual 缘 (相由成立) and cycles as one co-present cluster (同為一念); also commits to discrete moments (剎那之間分為三際), to be registered with 刹那 as a separate commitment.
Relativity is expressed with 看 and 收 (looking, taking in): observer words the plan replaces by classes.

相即 and whole-in-part containment (一即一切, 眼即耳, 重重無盡) are not readable: class equivalence would erase the differences the text keeps (參而不雜, 因果歷然). A candidate is a non-wellfounded (greatest fixed point) containment; open. 承遷’s 無孤單法 contradicts the grammar’s isolated events.
承遷 writes 無生生 (no arising-of-arising): a different sense of 生生 from the plan’s; polysemy to note.

corpus_problems: JSZ-P-07-009 reads 俱顯俱顯 in both FO2-KS-P.txt and FO2-KS.txt; the Taishō reading 俱隱俱顯 is from memory and was not checked.
JSZ-C-081 contains the private-use character U+F1367 (Supplementary Private Use Area-A) for 迴 in 由心?轉善成門; the base unit JSZ-P-07-032 has 迴轉.
JSZ-P-000 is not a contiguous string of FO2-KS.txt: there each gate name is followed by a 承遷 couplet (JSZ-C-005..014); the layer file joins the names. Anchored accordingly.
FO2-KS-C.txt has no gate labels; anchors in the commentary column come from position in FO2-KS.txt (all consistent with layer order).
JSZ-C-001..004 precede the 法藏 attribution line: they are 承遷 on the title.
